{{Quote|So&hellip;you take us for fools.|A Whiphid councilor, to Mirith Sinn|<ref name="Crimson Empire III 6" />}}
A [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] '''individual''' was a councilor within a governmental body of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] that included [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|chief of state]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]<ref name="Crimson Empire III 6" /> in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/crimsonempire3/index.html|text=Back in the Red: Dark Horse Comics Announces Long-Awaited Crimson Empire III Series}} places ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost]]'' to two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood]]'', which ''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]'' dates to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'', including ''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 6, must take place in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> The Whiphip insisted on the arrest of Organa Solo's security chief [[Mirith Sinn]] [[Battle of Orinda (13 ABY)|after a chain of events]] in which she was implicated. However, Organa Solo objected and ordered not to do so letting Sinn free.<ref name="Crimson Empire III 6" />
